3.      PUBLIC HEARING

       a) BYLAW NO. 1571
          "Langford Zoning Bylaw, Amendment No. 428, (3061 Jacklin Rd), 2015".

The Mayor opened the Public Hearing for Bylaw No. 1571 at 7:01 p.m.

Mayor Young advised members of the audience that any person present who believes that his or her
interest is affected by the proposed bylaws shall be given an opportunity to be heard on the matters
contained in the proposed bylaw. Those who wish to speak concerning this proposed bylaw should give
their name, address and views concerning the proposed bylaw. Mayor Young advised that after
everyone has expressed their views, he shall state three times "Is there anyone else who wishes to be
heard", and if no further views are forthcoming, the Public Hearing shall be declared closed.

The City Planner advised that Barry Weih, Wensley Architecture has applied on behalf of 3279321 Nova
Scotia Ltd. to amend the zoning of 3061 Jacklin Rd and that the purpose of the Public Hearing was to
hear from the public regarding Bylaw No. 1571 which, if adopted, would amend the zoning of 3061
Jacklin Rd from C3 (District Commercial) to C10 (Langford City Centre) Zone, to amend the density

                                                                                      Regular Meeting of Council
                                                                                                         th
                                                                                              January 18 , 2016
                                                                                                    Page 2 of 15


provisions of the C10 Zone, to allow gas stations the C10 Zone, and to allow apartments in the C10 Zone
to provide off-street parking in accordance with the City Centre ratio of the Zoning Bylaw.

This is being proposed in order to allow the subject property to be developed in a coordinated manner
with the adjacent property at 3067 Jacklin Rd, which is currently zoned C10. As part of this application, a
public hearing is required in accordance with the regulations of the Local Government Act.

In support of this application, the applicant has agreed to provide the following:

    •   $2,500,000 towards the general amenity reserve fund, as a bonus for increased density for all
        development within the C10 Zone as a whole.
    •   An updated traffic study to the satisfaction of the Director of Engineering.

The required traffic study has been provided and includes recommendations with regards to access
to/from Jacklin Rd and Jenkins Ave as well as off-site transportation network improvements to ensure
optimal vehicle movements to/from the proposed development. These access points and off-site
improvements will be implemented as part of the works and services installed for the development.

This proposal is consistent with the Official Community Plan Mixed-Use Employment Centre designation.
Notifications and advertisements have been placed as required by Council policy.

The Mayor called a first time for presentations.

Mayor Young called a second time for presentations.
The Mayor called a third and final time for presentation, there being none, the Mayor officially declared
the Public Hearing for Bylaw No. 1571 closed at 7:03 p.m.

        b) BYLAW NO. 1610
           "Langford Zoning Bylaw, Amendment No. 445, (2792 Leigh Rd), 2015".

The Mayor opened the Public Hearing for Bylaw No. 1610 at 7:03 p.m.

Mayor Young advised members of the audience that any person present who believes that his or her
interest is affected by the proposed bylaws shall be given an opportunity to be heard on the matters
contained in the proposed bylaw. Those who wish to speak concerning this proposed bylaw should give
their name, address and views concerning the proposed bylaw. Mayor Young advised that after
everyone has expressed their views, he shall state three times "Is there anyone else who wishes to be
heard", and if no further views are forthcoming, the Public Hearing shall be declared closed.

The City Planner advised that the City of Langford has made application to amend the zoning of 2792
Leigh Rd and that the purpose of the Public Hearing was to hear from the public regarding Bylaw No.
1610 which, if adopted, would amend the zoning of 2792 Leigh Rd from the R2 (One- and Two-Family
Residential) Zone to the BT1 (Business and Technology Park) Zone.

This is being proposed in order to allow for the development of a secondary suite in an accessory
building (aka: carriage house) in conjunction with the existing dwelling, or to allow for the development
of the site as business and technology park.
